# Kids Kiddle

> > A comprehensive kids encyclopedia providing accessible facts across science, education, and space exploration to support learning and homework help.

Kids Kiddle is an educational reference site designed specifically for children, offering factual information on core topics including astronomy, physics, biology, and educational systems. The site emphasizes the scientific method and famous scientists while making complex concepts understandable for young learners.

## Space & Astronomy

- [Universe Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/Universe): Universe facts covering Big Bang theory, galaxies, and cosmology
- [Planet Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/Planet): Planet facts covering solar system, dwarf planets, and exoplanets
- [Astronomy Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/Astronomy): Astronomy basics covering celestial objects and history of astronomy
- [Star Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/Star): Star facts covering stellar formation, lifecycle, and astronomy basics
- [Galaxy Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/Galaxy): Galaxy facts covering types, structure, and the Milky Way
- [Big Bang Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/Big_Bang): Big Bang theory, cosmology, and universe origins for kids
- [Black hole Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/Black_hole): Black holes, astrophysics, and supermassive black holes explained
- [Spaceflight Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/Spaceflight): Space exploration, spacecraft types, and space history for beginners

## Science & Nature

- [Science Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/Science): Science introduction covering physics, chemistry, biology, and scientific method
- [Nature Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/Nature): Nature facts covering earth science, ecosystems, geology, and weather
- [Experiment Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/Experiment): Experimental design and scientific method basics with controlled experiments
- [History of science Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/History_of_science): History of science from ancient civilizations to scientific revolution
- [Knowledge Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/Knowledge): Epistemology and knowledge definition covering belief, science, and philosophy

## Education & Learning

- [Education Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/Education): Comprehensive overview of education types and educational institutions
- [School Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/School): Educational overview of school types, institutions, and learning systems
- [Homework Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/Homework): Facts about homework, study habits, and educational benefits for students
- [Homeschooling Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/Homeschooling): Homeschooling overview covering alternative education and learning methods

## Solar System Objects

- [Asteroid Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/Asteroid): Asteroid facts covering asteroid belt, solar system, and space rocks
- [Comet Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/Comet): Comet facts covering solar system objects and spacecraft missions
